title: [PEN ’n’ DAITING] Two short-form hooks for one AI dating game: card duel + conversation twist
author: Think-Shoulder-4960
selftext:
Hi, I’m Tyr4nTX on Nexus Mods, where I create mods. I’m now building games as TyR Games.



I’m testing two different hooks for the same AI game instead of presenting a generic trailer:



1. Card-game hook — Roses & Runes, the fantasy card game inside PEN 'n' DAITING:

[https://www.youtube.com/shorts/c7t8gwdWDvI](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/c7t8gwdWDvI)



2. Conversation hook — an edited excerpt from an actual English AI companion reply:

[https://www.youtube.com/shorts/dBedd-m5XSs](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/dBedd-m5XSs)



The game connects AI companions and conversations with pen-and-paper adventures and a four-faction card game. For both clips I kept the footage feature-faithful, added a clear demo route, and disclosed AI use.



Free demo: [https://tyr4ntx1.itch.io/pen-n-daiting](https://tyr4ntx1.itch.io/pen-n-daiting)

Nexus profile: [https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tyr4nTX](https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tyr4nTX)



Disclosure: AI-generated artwork and AI-assisted development/marketing. This is an alpha; the full alpha is US$1.99 and live AI requires a provider account with separately paid credit.



I’d appreciate feedback on which hook makes you want to click first: the card-game mechanic or the companion’s personality?
